ABOUT GENEVIÈVE NIGHTINGALE

Master Level 11 Evidential Intuitive • Remote Viewer • Somatic Mystic

Geneviève Nightingale comes from a rare multi-lineage tapestry that includes the Soloveitchik scholars of Belarus, the Horovitz Russian mystics, the Petrakovich line of Odessa, and the Scottish/Celtic second-sight families of Beightol and McDowell. This ancestry forms the foundation of a naturally advanced intuitive system—one rooted in precision, depth, and multidimensional perception.

A lifelong mystic, Geneviève began practicing yoga at age three, developing extraordinary somatic awareness long before she had language for it. She later trained at some of the most respected studios in the country, including the historic Center for Yoga in Larchmont Village, Los Angeles, deepening her mastery of breath, embodiment, and energetic modulation. She's studied pilates in Big Bear Lake, CA under Siri Galliano and at the Gnostic Center in Los Angeles studying the works of Samael Aun Weor and kabbalah.

Trained and tested from age 11 in remote viewing, distance body scanning and energy healing, Genevieve has rare evidential accuracy that even the most seasoned working psychics cannot produce consistently. 

Her intuitive architecture mirrors the elite tradition of Russian evidential psychics, where perception is treated as a skill—disciplined, measurable, and grounded. Geneviève’s work integrates remote viewing, symbolic clairvoyance, subconscious pattern tracing, emotional-timeline mapping, and somatic field scanning into a single coherent reading style. Her INTP analytical structure refines this further, enabling her to synthesize data, patterns, and energetic signatures with exceptional clarity.

Her clients include individuals who require elevated discernment and discretion—people for whom accuracy, confidentiality, and depth are essential. They seek her insight for clarity in complex personal timelines, hidden dynamics, unresolved histories, and moments where a higher level of perceptual intelligence is required.

Geneviève’s gift is not simply intuitive—it is architectural, cognitive, and ancestral.
Her work is the convergence of lineage, training, neurology, and lived experience, forming an intuitive system of uncommon clarity and sophistication.

To sit with Geneviève is to enter a field of deep intelligence—
a place where the unseen becomes legible,
the complex becomes simple,
and the truth rises cleanly to the surface.
